name: Minh
description: Round chubby face with slightly droopy, sleepy eyes and a small nose; short tousled black hair that sticks up at the crown; warm light-tan skin; small and slightly stocky build; default expression is a dreamy, absent-minded half-smile that shifts to wide-eyed surprise or guilty grin
outfit: Oversized dusty-blue hoodie with a front pocket, soft grey sweatpants, white socks — no logos or text; a pair of wireless earbuds hanging loosely around the neck as a character prop
personality: Easily distracted and impulsive but genuinely sweet; quick to laugh at himself
